### Added

- (agent-platform) [The agent's default workspace in the agent form and the session pickers](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3227) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — More options in the agent form has `Default workspace`, also shown on the agent's page. Starting a session with the agent preselects it, unless you last picked another workspace with that agent in this browser. Needs agent-manager 2.11.0 or later.

### Fixed

- (muster) [The inbox's first read waits for the MCP sign-in status to settle](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3230) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — When a connector waits for your MCP sign-in as the portal opens, the notification inbox shows its summary toast again, which v3.19.0 had lost.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.19.1...v3.20.0
